reason: The only commit adds private terminal password handling to the upstream CLI Agent and its tests. It changes neither native inference source nor Metal/Vulkan kernels. DStudio's desktop Agent uses its own tool loop and resident-engine adapter, not this terminal UI.
method: Read all five changed files/diffs; compare git ls-tree -r --full-tree at base and tip excluding exactly those five paths. Hash the remaining newline-terminated listings; they are identical.

adaptation.behavior: Keep one close-on-exec slave descriptor until job cleanup on macOS; use a stable master descriptor for the test's restoration oracle; stop the test reader at actual EOF.
adaptation.validation: Same corrected oracle on baseline/candidate: baseline NO_TERMINAL, candidate seven fictional-password scenarios PASS. Actual EOF regression and 32 native normal/cancelled jobs without descriptor leaks; original failures retained.

limitations: Not a Metal long-context fix, LLM quality result, Linux/Vulkan/CUDA qualification, managed install upgrade or final app promotion. The current 27B common-100 replay remains on the old frozen engine and still has real failures. Earlier main-to-engine source comparisons remain separate required work.
